title: Staleness/refresh process + source version-drift detection
context: Documented datasets drift as sources (GEO/cBioPortal/ICGC) update. This task documents a process to detect drift from a recorded version, flags it via the validation script, turns stale entries into maintenance tasks, and re-archives the index to Zenodo on each version so prior versions stay citable. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Document a staleness/refresh process with source version-drift detection and Zenodo re-archival policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Documented process to detect when a documented dataset has drifted from its recorded version (GEO/cBioPortal/ICGC updates); validation script flags drift; stale entries become maintenance tasks.
Index re-archived to Zenodo on each version (new DOI), keeping prior versions citable.
